q1_issues.issue: "According to security sources" is not encoded at all — no AccordingTo atom and no source referent — and P's atoms are asserted at top level (merely at confidence 0.9), which the evidential-attribution rule's non-factive bar forbids.

The office premodifier "London Metropolitan Police Commissioner" is reduced to a bare (Member john_stevens commissioner) typing, dropping the qualifier instead of typing him through the whole title phrase per Compound concepts.

The resultative flat half (Member london_metropolitan_police alert) asserts that the force is "alert", a state the sentence never predicates: its source is a PP object noun ("on its highest state of alert"), which the prepositional-verb rule routes to an (On <event> …) oblique.
(Most high sk_alert_1 alert) drops the possessive restriction "its" and the head noun "state", widening the superlative from the force's own highest state to the highest alert simpliciter.

notes: The "following the warning" adjunct is handled exactly right — anchor-only typing plus (Before sk_warning_1 sk_place_1) and no tense on the warning — as are the deictic last_week and the past-host wrapper on the title typing. The blanket 0.9 confidences read as a hedge substituting for the AccordingTo attribution, which the instruction set does not license.
